introduction: Two read-only built-in tools in the `tools` package, `file_outline` (declarations of one file with line ranges) and `find_symbol` (ranked workspace-wide declaration lookup). They are built on the `outline` package and `tools.Walk` from spec 01_outline_and_walk, and use an in-memory symbol table that is built lazily, bounded by file count and wall time, and refreshed after AgentKit's own write and shell tools run.

glossary.CtagsRunner: The function from spec 01 that runs universal-ctags and returns ErrCtagsUnavailable when it is absent.
glossary.backend: The outline strategy that produced a file's declarations: go/ast, ctags, heuristic or none. Reported in Data and in the Text header of every result.
glossary.dirty path: A workspace-relative path marked by write_file or edit_file because the file may have changed since it was indexed.
glossary.generation counter: A counter advanced by every mark. A pass clears only marks that predate its start.
glossary.partial: A find_symbol answer produced after a build or refresh pass stopped at the MaxFiles or MaxDuration bound. It carries partial: true and partial_reason `files` or `time`.
glossary.racy window: The 2 s period after a file was indexed during which an unchanged size and mtime do not prove the file is unchanged, so revalidation always re-outlines it.
glossary.revalidation: A walk of the scope that compares size and mtime for each file, re-outlines changed or new files and drops files not seen in a completed walk.
glossary.smart-case: Matching rule where an all-lowercase query matches case-insensitively and any uppercase rune makes it case-sensitive.
glossary.symbol table: The in-memory per-file store of outline.File, size, modification time and index time behind find_symbol. It is created empty with the tool set, built on the first find_symbol call and discarded with the tool set.
glossary.test file: A file classified as a test by the fixed rule in 02-REQ-4.2; test files rank after non-test files.
glossary.whole-table mark: A flag set after execute, run_command or powershell returns. It means every indexed file must be revalidated before the next answer.

requirements.title: file_outline: arguments, source of truth and errors
requirements.rationale: A model that can outline one file from disk can read only the range it needs, and it must get the same file access that read_file gives it.

criteria.condition: file_outline is called with a path that resolves through Workspace.Resolve to a regular file
criteria.action: read and outline the file from disk on every call by calling outline.Outline with Root set to the workspace root and the same runner configuration the symbol table uses, and never consult the symbol table
criteria.contract: A successful ToolResult with Text and Data; two calls separated by an on-disk edit return different declarations without any refresh step

criteria.condition: the arguments cannot be parsed or the path is empty
criteria.action: return an error result without touching the filesystem
criteria.contract: ToolResult with OK false and error code invalid_arguments

criteria.condition: the path resolves outside the workspace root
criteria.action: refuse the call and outline nothing
criteria.contract: ToolResult with OK false and error code path_not_allowed

criteria.condition: os.Stat of the resolved path fails
criteria.action: return an error result
criteria.contract: ToolResult with OK false and error code read_failed

criteria.condition: the resolved path is a directory or another non-regular file
criteria.action: return the message produced by notAFile, which for a directory says to use list_files
criteria.contract: ToolResult with OK false and error code not_a_file

criteria.condition: outline.Outline returns an error, for example because the file is unreadable
criteria.action: return an error result carrying the underlying detail
criteria.contract: ToolResult with OK false and error code outline_failed

criteria.condition: the call context is cancelled
criteria.action: stop and return an error result
criteria.contract: ToolResult with OK false, error code aborted and detail "Operation aborted"

criteria.action: for any regular file inside the workspace that read_file can read, outline it without applying the ignore engine or the hidden-entry rule, including files that are gitignored or under dot-prefixed directories

requirements.title: file_outline: rendering and data
requirements.rationale: Compact text with line ranges lets the model follow the outline with read_file offset and limit without spending tokens on the whole file.

criteria.action: render Text as a header line of the form `<workspace-relative slash path>  (<backend>, <N> declarations[, <M> unexported not listed])` followed by one line per listed declaration in source order, where the unexported clause appears only when M is greater than 0

criteria.condition: include_private is false or omitted
criteria.action: count unexported declarations in the total but omit them from the listed lines, and list them when include_private is true
render each declaration line as `L<start>-<end>` followed by the declaration's Signature, and render `L<start>` alone when EndLine is 0 or equals StartLine

criteria.condition: a listed declaration has a non-empty Container
criteria.action: indent its line two further spaces unless its Signature already contains the container's name, as a Go method receiver does

criteria.condition: the file has no declarations
criteria.action: render the header and one line stating that no declarations were found, with no listed declaration lines

criteria.condition: the file has no declarations and the backend is none
criteria.action: make the line state the reason in neutral wording (language not recognised, file too large, or binary) and suggest read_file or search_files
carry in Data the keys file (the outline.File), backend, declarations (total count) and listed (count of lines rendered)

requirements.title: find_symbol: input validation and name matching
requirements.rationale: Bad input must be rejected before any walk starts, and matching rules must be predictable so a model can find methods by bare or qualified name.

criteria.condition: name is empty after trimming whitespace or is longer than 256 bytes
criteria.action: reject the call before any walk, subprocess or file read
criteria.contract: ToolResult with OK false and error code invalid_arguments; a 256-byte name is accepted and a 257-byte name is rejected

criteria.condition: kind, after trimming and lower-casing, is not one of func, method, type, class, interface, enum, trait, const, var, module, macro
criteria.action: reject the call before any walk
criteria.contract: ToolResult with OK false, error code invalid_arguments and a detail listing the eleven allowed values

criteria.condition: path resolves outside the workspace root
criteria.action: refuse the call before any walk
criteria.contract: ToolResult with OK false and error code path_not_allowed; tools.Walk is not called

criteria.condition: path does not exist
criteria.action: return an error result before any walk
criteria.contract: ToolResult with OK false and error code read_failed

criteria.condition: path names a regular file
criteria.action: reject the call with a detail saying to use file_outline
criteria.contract: ToolResult with OK false and error code invalid_arguments

criteria.condition: exact is false or omitted
criteria.action: match Decl.Name by prefix with smart-case, so an all-lowercase name matches case-insensitively and a name containing any uppercase rune matches case-sensitively

criteria.condition: exact is true
criteria.action: match only declarations whose compared string equals name exactly and case-sensitively

criteria.condition: name contains a dot
criteria.action: compare name against Container + "." + Name of each declaration that has a container under the same prefix, smart-case and exact rules, and compare a name without a dot against Decl.Name alone, so `Runner.Run` and `Run` both find method Run on Runner

requirements.title: find_symbol: filters, ranking, limits and result shape
requirements.rationale: A bounded, deterministic, best-first list with a working truncation marker lets the model act on the first answer instead of paging blindly.

criteria.action: for any query over an unchanged tree, order matches by exact before prefix (an exact match under smart-case counts as exact), exported before unexported, non-test before test files, shorter path first, then path, then StartLine, and return the identical order on every repeated call

classify a file as a test file only by this rule: Go `_test.go`; Python `test_*.py` and `*_test.py`; JS/TS `*.test.*` and `*.spec.*`; Java, Kotlin, C# and Ruby files whose base name ends in `Test`, `Tests` or `_spec`; and any file under a directory named test, tests, __tests__ or spec

criteria.condition: max_results is omitted, zero, negative or above 50
criteria.action: apply clampLimit with default 20 and cap SymbolResultCap of 50, returning at most that many matches
criteria.contract: max_results=200 returns at most 50 symbols; omitted returns at most 20

criteria.condition: more matches exist than the effective max_results
criteria.action: return only the first max_results matches, append the marker built by SymbolMarker(limit) using capMarker("results", "max_results", limit, SymbolResultCap, ...), set Data truncated and note, and set ToolMetadata.Truncated with TruncatedByLines
criteria.contract: Below the cap the marker names max_results=<next>; at the cap it says 50 is the maximum and advises narrowing with path, kind or exact

criteria.action: carry in Data the keys symbols (SymbolMatch entries with JSON keys path, backend, kind, name, container, signature, exported, start_line, end_line), truncated, backends (backend name to count of indexed files within the queried scope), files_indexed, and note and partial when they apply

render Text as a header `<N> symbols matching "<name>"  (index: <F> files; <backend> <count>, ...)`, then one line per match of the form `<path>:<start>-<end>  <kind>  <signature>`, then any marker or partial note, replacing control characters in printed paths with `?` while Data keeps the real path and never printing a signature longer than outline produced

criteria.condition: no declaration matches
criteria.action: return a successful result whose Text states that nothing matched and still shows the index line
criteria.contract: ToolResult with OK true and an empty symbols slice

criteria.condition: kind or path is supplied
criteria.action: keep only declarations of that kind and only files under that directory, and count only those files in backends and files_indexed

requirements.title: Symbol table: lazy build, scope and bounds
requirements.rationale: The table must agree with search_files about which files exist, cost nothing until first used, and never hang or error when a tree is huge or ctags is stuck.

criteria.action: create the symbol table empty with fileTools and perform no walk, subprocess or file read at All() time or when only file_outline is used

criteria.condition: find_symbol is called and the table has never been built
criteria.action: build it over the workspace root from the regular files tools.Walk yields with IncludeHidden false and Options.Ignore, so the indexed set equals the set search_files selects and contains nothing under dot-prefixed directories or through symlinks
obtain declarations from outline.OutlineMany in batches of at most 100 files and keep per file its outline.File, size, modification time and index time

criteria.condition: a pass has seen SymbolOptions.MaxFiles regular files of any language and the walk yields another
criteria.action: stop the pass at the first file past the limit, keep the table built so far, and use 50 000 when MaxFiles is zero or negative
criteria.contract: The result carries partial: true and partial_reason `files`

criteria.condition: the SymbolOptions.MaxDuration deadline passes during the walk or outlining
criteria.action: cancel a derived context passed to OutlineMany so a stuck ctags process is killed, leave the interrupted batch unindexed, keep the table built so far, and use 2 s when MaxDuration is zero or negative
criteria.contract: The result is OK with partial: true and partial_reason `time`, returned within the deadline plus a small margin, never an error

criteria.condition: a pass stopped at a bound
criteria.action: add a note produced by SymbolPartialMarker telling the model to narrow with path or fall back to search_files
criteria.contract: Data has partial true, partial_reason and note; Text ends with the same note

criteria.condition: find_symbol is called while the table is partial
criteria.action: run another pass that skips files whose size and mtime are unchanged and indexes files not yet seen, so each call indexes more files until the table is complete

criteria.condition: path is given
criteria.guard: the table is not yet complete
criteria.action: walk from the workspace root and return SkipDir for every directory that is neither an ancestor of nor inside path, so ignore layers above path still apply

requirements.title: Symbol table: freshness after AgentKit's own tools
requirements.rationale: A model must never be answered from stale data about a file it just changed through write_file, edit_file or a shell tool.

criteria.condition: the table is complete and nothing is marked
criteria.action: answer from memory without calling tools.Walk or outline.OutlineMany

criteria.condition: write_file or edit_file finishes its write attempt, whether it succeeded or failed
criteria.action: mark the file's workspace-relative path dirty while still holding the per-path lock, before releasing it

criteria.condition: execute, run_command or powershell returns with any outcome, including timeout and non-zero exit
criteria.action: mark the whole table for revalidation by wrapping the three tools' Execute, leaving the standalone constructors and their tests unchanged

criteria.condition: find_symbol runs and a dirty path is already in the table
criteria.action: stat the path and re-outline it if it is still a regular file, or drop its entry if it is gone or no longer regular

criteria.condition: find_symbol runs and a dirty path is not in the table or has base name .gitignore
criteria.action: escalate to whole-table revalidation, because only the walk's ignore engine can say whether a new file is visible

criteria.condition: revalidation runs over the whole workspace or the part under path
criteria.action: compare size and mtime of every walked file, re-outline only files that changed, are new, or have an mtime within 2 s of their index time, and drop entries not seen in a completed walk

criteria.condition: a revalidation pass finishes
criteria.guard: it covered the whole workspace and completed within MaxFiles and MaxDuration
criteria.action: clear the whole-table mark, and leave the mark set after a pass scoped by path or stopped at a bound
for any mark made while a build or refresh pass is running, advance a generation counter on the mark and have the pass clear only marks that predate its start, so the mark is still set after the pass

requirements.title: Concurrency, cancellation and failure containment
requirements.rationale: Parallel tool calls share one table, and a model call blocked behind a slow build must still be cancellable.

criteria.condition: a find_symbol call is waiting for the table lock behind a running build and its context is cancelled
criteria.action: abandon the wait immediately instead of waiting for the build to finish
criteria.contract: ToolResult with OK false, error code aborted and detail "Operation aborted", returned before the build completes

criteria.action: guard all table state with one context-abandonable lock, serialize builds and refreshes, read the table to answer a query under the same lock, and for any set of concurrent find_symbol, write_file and edit_file calls produce no data race under `go test -race`

criteria.condition: write_file, edit_file or a shell tool marks the table while a build is in progress
criteria.action: set the mark without waiting for the build, blocking no longer than it takes to set a flag

criteria.condition: the find_symbol call context is cancelled during a build or refresh
criteria.action: return aborted and not a partial answer
criteria.contract: ToolResult with OK false, error code aborted and detail "Operation aborted"; partial is reserved for MaxFiles and MaxDuration

criteria.condition: ctags fails, is unavailable, or the Runner returns an error
criteria.action: fall back to another backend for the affected files instead of failing the call
criteria.contract: ToolResult with OK true whose backend field and header name the backend actually used

criteria.action: run no shell and invoke ctags only through outline and CtagsRunner, and return errors in the ToolResult instead of terminating the process

requirements.title: Tool wiring, options and defaults
requirements.rationale: The tools must appear in the default set and the prompt consistently, and tests need a deterministic backend seam, without adding a dependency.

criteria.action: gain a field Symbols of type SymbolOptions with MaxFiles int, MaxDuration time.Duration, DisableCtags bool and Runner func(ctx context.Context, args []string) ([]byte, error), where a zero or negative MaxFiles or MaxDuration means the default
by default construct CtagsRunner(opts.Env) lazily on first use by either tool, so All() spawns nothing and universal-ctags is used where installed and heuristics where it is not

criteria.condition: Symbols.DisableCtags is true or Symbols.Runner is non-nil
criteria.action: force the runner nil when DisableCtags is true, and use a non-nil Runner in place of the default, identically for file_outline and find_symbol

return exactly read_file, write_file, edit_file, list_files, find_files, search_files, file_outline, find_symbol, execute, run_command, powershell in that order, and FileNavigationTools() return exactly list_files, find_files, search_files, file_outline, find_symbol

criteria.condition: execute is in the active tool set
criteria.guard: none of list_files, find_files, search_files, file_outline, find_symbol is present
criteria.action: emit ExecuteFallbackGuideline, and suppress it when only file_outline is present

be Builtin and Parallel with no write capability, not Sequential and absent from guard.ShellToolNames, with PromptGuidelines "Before reading a large file, outline it and read only the range you need." and "Use find_symbol to locate a declaration; search_files for usages and text." respectively
use the memoized Options.Ignore held in fileTools for every walk
remain standard-library-only and cgo-free, add no go.mod entry and no internal/policy allowedModules entry, and leave every existing tool's description, schema, result shape and marker text unchanged

requirements.title: Documentation
requirements.rationale: The project's steering treats outdated docs as regressions.

criteria.action: list file_outline and find_symbol in the tool list and state in "What is not built" that references and callers remain unbuilt
describe the symbol table and its place under the tools package
add a Symbols row to the tools.Options table, add the two tool names to the tools.All sentence, and state the limits: find_symbol default 20 and cap 50 results, 50 000 files and 2 s
record that references and callers remain unbuilt with a pointer to this spec's Non-goals, and leave docs/api.md unmodified

execution_paths.title: A model outlines a file and reads only the range it needs

steps.action: calls file_outline with path internal/agentrun/phase.go
resolves the path through Workspace.Resolve, stats it and reads the file from disk
calls outline.Outline with the workspace root and the lazily built runner
renders the header with backend and counts plus one line per listed declaration with its L<start>-<end> range
calls read_file with offset and limit taken from a listed range and receives only that declaration

execution_paths.title: Cold find_symbol builds the table and returns a ranked answer

steps.action: calls find_symbol with name Run
validates name, kind and path before any walk
walks the workspace root with tools.Walk, IncludeHidden false and the memoized ignore options, collecting regular files
outlines the files in batches of at most 100 through outline.OutlineMany, which uses CtagsRunner or falls back to heuristics
filters, ranks and truncates matches, then returns Text with the index header and Data with symbols and backends

execution_paths.title: An edit through edit_file is visible to the next find_symbol

steps.action: calls edit_file to add function NewThing to a Go file
writes the file and, still holding the per-path lock, marks the workspace-relative path dirty before releasing the lock
calls find_symbol with name NewThing
stats the dirty path, re-outlines it and clears only the marks that predate the pass
returns the new declaration with its line range

execution_paths.title: A new file or a .gitignore change escalates to revalidation

steps.action: calls write_file to create a new source file or change a .gitignore
writes the file and marks its path dirty under the per-path lock
calls find_symbol for a name declared in the new file
sees a dirty path not in the table or named .gitignore and escalates to a whole-table revalidation walk
indexes new visible files, drops files no longer visible and clears the whole-table mark
returns matches consistent with the walk's ignore rules

execution_paths.title: A shell command deletes a file and the symbol disappears

steps.action: calls execute with a command that removes a source file
lets the command finish and then marks the whole table for revalidation whatever the outcome
calls find_symbol for a name declared in the removed file
revalidates by walking, re-outlines files that changed or fall in the 2 s racy window, and drops the entry for the unseen file
returns a successful no-match result that still shows the index line

execution_paths.title: A bound stops the build and later calls finish it

steps.action: calls find_symbol on a large tree or while ctags is slow
stops the pass at MaxFiles or at MaxDuration, cancelling the derived context so the stuck ctags batch is killed and left unindexed
returns an OK result with partial true, partial_reason and the SymbolPartialMarker note
calls find_symbol again or narrows with path
skips unchanged files and indexes files not yet seen, so the table grows with each call

execution_paths.title: A call blocked behind a long build is abandoned

steps.action: issues a find_symbol call while another find_symbol build is running
holds the abandonable lock for the running build, so the second call waits
cancels the second call's context
returns aborted with detail "Operation aborted" before the build completes, while the build continues
